background_image_description: A light teal background with a grid pattern. The grid lines are thin and evenly spaced, creating a subtle texture. The color transitions from a lighter shade on the left to a slightly darker shade on the right.

nodes.svg_description: A plain white background fills the frame.
A light green oval shape is centered on a white background. The oval is slightly elongated and has a subtle gradient, giving it a soft, natural appearance.
A stylized jar with a yellow lid and dark green outline contains three heart-shaped decorations. Two are red and one is yellow. The jar is centered on a white background.
A completely white image with no visible features or objects.

A dark green, elongated handle with two small white circles near its ends is shown against a white background. The handle has a curved, slightly tapered shape with a lighter green inner section visible at the top.

A dark green hourglass shape with a lighter green interior is shown against a white background. The upper portion curves inward, forming a rounded top, while the lower portion curves outward and downward. A small white circle is visible near the upper left portion of the hourglass.

nodes.text: Write down your favorite self-care ideas on strips of paper.

nodes.svg_description: A dark green circle with a thick, dark green border encloses a lighter green inner circle. Inside the inner circle, the number "3" is displayed in dark green. Two small white circles are positioned near the number.

nodes.text: Whenever you're feeling down, stressed out, or drained – pull out a strip of paper and then do that activity.

nodes.svg_description: A light green, curved, horizontal shape is centered on a white background. The shape is smooth and continuous, with no visible breaks or edges.
